verdict.rationale: White-label embedding is a fair question for an automation platform, but nothing in the evidence documents an embedded, white-label, or customer-facing integration offering. The REST API, OAuth client flows, TypeScript SDK and MCP server are developer building blocks for integrating with a user's own Make account. They are not a white-label embedding capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the automation platform white-label inside my own product for my customers
